registration.scale_policy: preserve source pixel scale within each sequence; do not upscale

wave.transition_back_to_idle: crossfade to idle_01 in 120ms after final hold

point.transition_back_to_idle: crossfade to idle_01 in 120ms after final hold

blink.transition_back_to_idle: return to blink_01 close-up; do not cut directly to full-body idle
blink.context_note: Close-up framing is not registration-compatible with the full-body idle sequence.

head_turn.transition_back_to_idle: play canonical order in reverse to head_turn_01; do not cut directly to full-body idle
head_turn.context_note: Close-up framing is not registration-compatible with the full-body idle sequence.

expressions.transition_back_to_idle: crossfade only within an approved close-up context
expressions.context_note: These are discrete expression masters, not interpolation frames. Do not play them as a sequence.

useful.transition_back_to_idle: crossfade to idle_01 only when scale and placement have been matched by the consuming composition
useful.context_note: These are discrete useful poses, not animation frames.
